phonemes.text: In September 1854, cholera killed one hundred and twenty-seven people in a single day in one London neighbourhood.
phonemes.ipa: ɪn sɛptˈɛmbɚ wˈʌn θˈaʊzənd ˈeɪthˈʌndɹɪd fˈɪfti fˈɔːɹ kˈɑːlɚɹə kˈɪld wˈʌn hˈʌndɹɪd ænd twˈɛntisˈɛvən pˈiːpəl ɪn ɐ sˈɪŋɡəl dˈeɪ ɪn wˈʌn lˈʌndən nˈeɪbɚhˌʊd

phonemes.text: John Snow traced it to one water pump and had the handle removed.
phonemes.ipa: dʒˈɑːn snˈoʊ tɹˈeɪst ɪt tə wˈʌn wˈɔːɾɚ pˈʌmp ænd hæd ðə hˈændəl ɹᵻmˈuːvd

phonemes.text: But look at his own data: the outbreak was already falling.
phonemes.ipa: bˌʌt lˈʊk æt hɪz ˈoʊn dˈeɪɾə ðɪ ˈaʊtbɹeɪk wʌz ɔːlɹˌɛdi fˈɔːlɪŋ

phonemes.text: The handle probably stopped a second wave; the map is what proved the water did it.
phonemes.ipa: ðə hˈændəl pɹˈɑːbəbli stˈɑːpt ɐ sˈɛkənd wˈeɪv ðə mˈæp ɪz wʌt pɹˈuːvd ðə wˈɔːɾɚ dˈɪd ɪt
